title: Prove model-to-quantity extraction and Construction Graph mapping
objective: Demonstrate that representative CAD/BIM model data can be transformed into deterministic, provenance-preserving quantity records and canonical Construction Graph objects, propagating controlled changes to downstream estimate/RFQ contract boundaries, without making the source engine or IFC representation the system of record. Evidence target: CAD/BIM Model Version -> Quantity Records -> Construction Graph -> Downstream Estimate/RFQ Contracts.
acceptance_criteria: A representative fixture completes model -> quantity -> Construction Graph mapping with deterministic numerical assertions.
At least five quantity types or measurement classes are demonstrated where applicable to the fixture.
A controlled model revision produces an exact, explainable quantity delta.
Unchanged elements retain stable canonical identity and unchanged quantity state.
Provenance, versioning and uncertainty metadata survive the mapping.
The resulting Graph objects are sufficient for downstream estimate/RFQ interfaces without direct engine coupling.
Any lossiness, ambiguity, unsupported geometry, unit limitations, or tolerance issues are explicitly documented.
Results support, reject, or defer the candidate quantity/Graph integration under the frozen architecture.
non_goals: No production estimate or RFQ implementation.
risk_assumptions: DEPENDENCY-GATE FLAG: per issue #4 this work item depends on RESEARCH-CAD-001 (VERIFIED), RESEARCH-CAD-002 (MERGED, VERIFIED not yet issued) and RESEARCH-CAD-003 (MERGED as f1f900e with green runs #28/#5, VERIFIED explicitly reserved by DEC-002 and not yet issued). The validator's dependency invariant will therefore report exactly two failing checks until the Architect records the pending verification decisions. The invariant is NOT weakened silently; resolution path: Architect records VERIFIED for CAD-002 and CAD-003 against their merge revisions, then governance validation turns fully green (all evidence is attached to the merge commits). RESOLUTION (2026-08-25T09:45:00Z, PR #21 comment 5408555197): the Architect directed the formal post-merge verification of CAD-002 against da85d8d and CAD-003 against f1f900e; both MERGED->VERIFIED transitions are recorded in this revision (DEC-002/DEC-003 in their records, entered by the implementer on the explicit directive per the RESEARCH-CAD-001 DEC-003 provenance convention). The dependency invariant now evaluates green with no rule change.

Architecture version: this record targets v1.1 per the execution directive ('Architecture: v1.1 frozen'); the work item was created after v1.1 became active, so unlike RESEARCH-CAD-003 it binds to the active version. The issue body's 'v1.0 remains frozen' text predates the ACR-002 merge.

Mixed-unit fixture: ifcopenshell's default project length unit is MILLIMETRE (CAD-001 finding); the mixed-unit demonstration uses this behavior deliberately, with explicit conversion factors recorded in quantity provenance.
Downstream estimate/RFQ coverage is CONTRACT-LEVEL ONLY (typed interface dataclasses and deterministic derivations as evidence), per the non-goals.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic benchmark suite covering the six issue scopes: fixture corpus (mixed units, instanced elements, revisions), extraction (rules/tolerances, measured-vs-calculated-vs-unsupported), provenance/versioning (immutable historical states, reproducible re-extraction), Construction Graph mapping (domain-id keyed, lineage preserved), change propagation (exact deltas, unchanged-element identity, change records), downstream readiness (estimate/RFQ contract evidence).
Exact fixture definitions and expected quantities stored in the repository.
Numerical assertions with explicit tolerances and units.
Epistemic distinction of OBSERVED/CALCULATED/UNKNOWN quantity states.
